evidence.observation: Pressure rose steadily from ~2.98 Torr (ramp) to 3.437 Torr during growth while Ar held at ~100 sccm
Exhaust O2 rose monotonically from ~5 ppm to 51.5 ppm during growth, showing air getting in
MFC reading steady at setpoint, so the flow source did not cause the pressure rise
Temperature stable at 750 °C after a small overshoot, so the thermocouple and heater look normal

args.missing_evidence: A leak-up check (isolate the tube and watch the pressure rise rate) or a helium leak check on the flanges and seals would confirm the leak. Ruling out a blocked exhaust would need the pump or exhaust line conductance, but a blockage would not explain the rising O2.
